current.text: Brooklyn's projected depth chart has him in the bench rotation. Mikel Brown Jr. and Egor Demin are the projected starting guards.
Brooklyn drafted a point guard at pick 6 and added Julius Randle, who is expected to handle the ball a lot.
He will handle the ball less and has to fight for bench ball-handling minutes. The expert sees no real shot at fantasy value.
Coach Jordi Fernandez wants several ball handlers and connective playmakers instead of one traditional point guard.
Brooklyn is projected as one of the worst teams, at about 28 wins. Houston controls its pick, so the Nets have no reason to tank.
Second-half minutes are uncertain. The young players the expert expects to gain minutes are Brown, Demin, Clowney and Minott, not Traore.
Brooklyn has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league. With a March 28 end, it plays 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks, which is 10 games with one back-to-back.

note: Do not draft him in our league. He is ranked 380 on Yahoo and 244 on ESPN, both sites value him at 0 USD, and that is far outside our 144-player pool. His projected line (about 41% FG on 9 shots, 2.3 TO, 4.0 AST) helps no build, and as a bench guard behind Brown Jr. and Demin he will see less of the ball. Only look at him on waivers if Brown Jr. or Demin misses time early in the season.
